transcript: There are three things about other people that life will eventually teach you to accept. When you stop fighting these truths, your mind becomes lighter. First, if they wanted to, they would. If they could, they would. No explanation is missing. No timing is wrong. Their actions are already the answer. Second, you cannot change another human being. You can offer kindness. You can share a meal. You can speak gently. You can inspire. But change only happens when someone is ready to meet themselves. Third, release the anger you carry because people are not who you hoped they would be. They are not here to fulfill your expectations. They are here to reveal your attachment to them. These truths are not easy. They ask you to let go of control. They ask you to stop negotiating with reality. But when you accept them, life becomes quieter. Your energy returns. And peace no longer depends on someone else becoming different. If you know someone who is tired but doesn't know how to rest, send this to them. And if you're ready to go deeper, the way back to stillness is in my bio.
